originality_note: Generated without source or reference images. The prompts explicitly reject imitation of Ark Nova and other board-game artwork.
prompt_assembly: The final prompt for each card is shared_prompt followed by that card's prompt_detail.
shared_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original 16:9 landscape animal-card thumbnail for an open-source browser board game
Style/medium: contemporary cut-paper collage mixed with matte gouache; layered rounded paper shapes, subtle tactile paper grain, crisp thumbnail-readable silhouette, polished editorial wildlife illustration; use an original visual identity and composition, not the artwork or composition of Ark Nova or any existing board game
Composition/framing: single clearly identifiable animal as the dominant subject, full or nearly full body, centered within the middle 80% of a wide horizontal frame; unobstructed face and species-defining anatomy; simple layered habitat with shallow depth; edge-safe for later 16:9 crop
Color palette: natural species colors supported by forest green, coral, ochre, cream, and teal accents
Constraints: biologically recognizable species; no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, card frame, UI, icons, captions, signage, human-made props, or extra decorative border; no copied poses or recognizable board-game composition
